MODULUS = 1000000007
visitedStates = [False] * 1010101

def traverse(visited, start, base, modVal):
    if not visited[start]:
        visited[start] = True
        traverse(visited, (start * base) % modVal, base, modVal)

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    answer = 1
    if k == 1:
        answer = p
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not visitedStates[i]:
            traverse(visitedStates, i, k, p)
            answer = (answer * p) % MODULUS
    print(answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
